scenes.text: Perplexity's *AI agent* now runs *fully on your Mac*, offline

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: Oct 20: Perplexity Computer for Mac added a fully local mode. The model runs on your machine; nothing leaves it.
It works inside Notes, Messages, Mail, Keynote and Numbers.

scenes.title: The *money* use
lines: Freelancers with client files under NDA can finally put an AI agent on them.
Try: 'Open the Q3 numbers, build a Keynote summary, draft the client email.' All offline.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: Perplexity recommends 36 GB of unified memory; hybrid mode starts at 24 GB. Older Macs are out.
Web and current info still need the cloud. Source: MacRumors and AppleInsider, Oct 20, 2026.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: Pro, Max and Enterprise plans. Perplexity Pro is $20 a month.
Perplexity hasn't said whether local runs use credits. Check before you lean on it.

scenes.text: Would you let an *AI agent* loose on your files? *Yes or no* below.
